description: Structure de l'espace aérien partiel au sol à 2500 pieds AMSL is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerie van Landsverdediging. Map showing structural elements of Belgian airspace (during the hours of military operations). The data is managed with AutoCAD. Coverage: Ministerie van Landsverdediging. The portal shows the English title as "Partial Airspace Structure Ground to 2500 ft AMSL" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerie van Landsverdediging. Its keywords include LUCHTRUIM, Luchtverkeersgebieden, STRUCTUUR VH LUCHTRUIM, LUCHTACTIVITEITEN, AIRSPACE, OPERATIONEEL COMMANDO. The listing shows 2001-04-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
